user.title: Connect to Stash
user.description: Enter the URL of your Stash server. The API key is only needed if authentication is enabled in Stash.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Stash
reauth_confirm.description: Stash rejected the API key for {url}. Enter a new API key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Stash. Check the URL and that Stash is running.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by Stash.

abort.already_configured: This Stash server is already configured.

user.title: Add image feed
user.description: A feed shows a random image from Stash. Leave tags empty to pick from the whole library.

data_description.tags: Stash tag IDs. Only images that have at least one of these tags are picked.
data_description.auto_refresh_seconds: Optional. Seconds between automatic picks of a new image (minimum 10). Leave empty to turn it off; the refresh_feed service still works.

reconfigure.title: Edit image feed
reconfigure.description: Change the name, tags, or auto refresh interval of this feed.

data_description.tags: Stash tag IDs. Only images that have at least one of these tags are picked.
data_description.auto_refresh_seconds: Optional. Seconds between automatic picks of a new image (minimum 10). Leave empty to turn it off; the refresh_feed service still works.

error.auto_refresh_too_short: Auto refresh must be at least 10 seconds, or left empty to turn it off.
